title: SongPal Transmission (Instrumenta… x SongPal Transmission (Instrumenta… (Mashup)
style: industrial electronic, post-punk rap, indie electronic rock, narrative spoken-word, assertive baritone lead, raspy older male echo, layered harmony stacks, call-and-response hooks, steel-string muted strums, live drum kit backbeat, snare rimshots, analog glitch synth, sidechained sub-bass, tape saturation, plate delay, mid-tempo pulse, raw energy, late-night urgency, 90s club grit - international instrument use as multicultural
lyrics:
[Beat kicks in, slow build]

(Whispers over the beat)
Yeah… keep it low…
Let it breathe…

[Drop 1 – Groove Enters]

(Bass hits)
Uh…
Feel that?
Right there…

Ride the kick,
Let the snare talk,
Hands up,
Don’t stop.

[Break – Space]

Silence on the one—
…wait for it…

[Drop 2 – Both Tracks Hit]

Left side, right side,
Two tracks, one vibe.
Fade it in, cut it out,
Hear that switch, no doubt.

[Build – Tension]

Bring it up, bring it up—
Hold…
Don’t drop—

[Massive Drop]

Now!

(Bass stabs)
Boom–boom–clack,
Bring the whole room back.
Spin it, flip it,
Double on the kick drum,
Low-end heavy
When the subs start to hit, run.

[Mid-Set Switch-Up]

Filter that A-side,
Echo on the B.
Pan it left, pan it right,
Feel it in 3D.

Beat over beat,
No words, just motion,
Two songs, one wave,
Dancing like an ocean.

[Final Build – Chant]

Up, up—don’t breathe,
Hands high—don’t leave.
Closer—feel the floor bend,
Stay with me ‘til the very last end.

[Final Drop / Outro]

Last hit—let it roll,
Bass line shaking every soul.
Cut the highs, let the lows remain…
Silence…
Then the kick again—
